description:
Use this when you need a deterministic division-specific offset in 2027. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when the division is unknown or replacement-day/employer rules matter.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts dates using the selected Malaysian division's 2027 official public-holiday schedule and weekly baseline.
Example user requests: Add five Kuala Lumpur working days after 2027-02-05.
Inputs: start_date (date); division (enum); working_days (integer).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2027-02-05","division":"KUL","working_days":1}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added, calendar_days_elapsed, public_holidays_skipped, territory, territory_name, division, division_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, weekend_days, holiday_names, holiday_observed, rest_day_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_scope, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: move one day at a time; decrement remaining only when selected status.is_working_day=true
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/malaysia-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/malaysia-add-working-days.md

division.description: Required federal-territory/state code: KUL, LBN, PJY, JHR, KDH, KTN, MLK, NSN, PHG, PRK, PLS, PNG, SBH, SWK, SGR or TRG.

working_days.description: Signed offset; start date is excluded for non-zero offsets.

name: add_my_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Selected division's federal/state public holidays and weekly baseline.

day_type.description: Regular weekday, official weekend or public holiday.

holiday_names.description: Official events applying to the date.

holiday_observed.description: Always false here because no substitute date is inferred.

is_working_day.description: False for the division's declared weekly baseline or applicable official holiday.

rest_day_policy.description: Employer roster and replacement-day policy are not inferred.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Add Malaysia Division Working Days
